@graph.name: 5 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Nature Trip from Surabaya
@graph.description: Private 5-day East Java tour: Ijen crater, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu canyon, Bromo sunrise. More time at each stop vs the 4-day version. All-inclusive.

@graph.name: Day 1: Surabaya to Bondowoso for Ijen Staging
@graph.description: The route opens with a transfer from Surabaya to the Bondowoso side so the Ijen segment can be handled properly. Screening is completed after hotel check-in before the climb window begins.

item.name: Surabaya to Bondowoso Transfer
item.description: Pickup by our team at your location in Surabaya. After meeting at the confirmed pick-up point, begin the overland transfer toward Bondowoso (Ijen area) as scheduled in the route plan.

item.name: Lunch at Local Restaurant
item.description: Stop at a local restaurant for lunch (cost not included). This is the planned meal break during the transfer, allowing time to order food and rest briefly before continuing to Bondowoso.

item.name: Local Restaurant to Bondowoso Transfer
item.description: Continue the overland journey from the restaurant toward Bondowoso, arriving in time for hotel check-in.

item.name: Check-in Bondowoso Hotel
item.description: Arrive in Bondowoso and complete the hotel check-in process. This step covers arrival at the accommodation and the basic check-in procedure so you can settle in after the transfer.

item.name: Ijen health screening
item.description: A health screening will be conducted by medical personnel directly at your hotel. This is a scheduled screening session as listed in the itinerary to complete the required check before the Ijen-area program.

item.name: Dinner at Accommodation
item.description: Dinner is served at the accommodation or a nearby restaurant (included). This is the planned dinner time after the transfer and screening, scheduled as an included meal for the day.

@graph.name: Day 2: Ijen Climb and Transfer to the Papuma Side
@graph.description: After the Ijen sequence, the route continues south toward the Papuma side. This day is about volcanic seriousness first, then broader East Java contrast as the route begins to open up.

item.name: Ijen Tour
item.description: Take the Ijen tour. This block represents completing the scheduled Ijen program for the day, finished in full before the onward travel sequence to Jember and Papuma Beach.

item.name: Return to Bondowoso Hotel
item.description: Depart from the Ijen area after completing the hike and transfer back to the hotel in Bondowoso.

item.name: Ijen Hotel Check-out
item.description: Check out hotels in the Ijen area. This is the departure step from the Ijen-area accommodation after completing the Ijen tour block, transitioning to lunch and onward travel.

item.name: Lunch at Restaurant
item.description: Lunch at a local restaurant (included). This is the planned meal stop after check-out, providing time to eat before the transfer toward Jember.

item.name: Journey to Jember
item.description: Journey to Jember. This segment is the overland transfer from the Ijen-area base (Bondowoso City) to Jember as scheduled for the day’s long itinerary.

item.name: Jember Hotel Check-in
item.description: Arrive in Jember, check-in, then head straight to Papuma Beach. This step covers arriving at the Jember hotel, completing check-in efficiently, and continuing onward to the beach for the late-afternoon program.

item.name: Transfer to Papuma Beach
item.description: Depart from the Jember hotel and transfer to Papuma Beach in time for the sunset window.

item.name: Papuma Sunset Experience
item.description: Enjoying the sunset. This is the dedicated time window at Papuma Beach to relax, take photos, and experience the late-day atmosphere during sunset hour.

item.name: Return to Jember Hotel
item.description: Back to the hotel in Jember. This is the return transfer segment after the sunset stop, concluding the day’s coastal visit upon arrival back at the Jember accommodation.

@graph.name: Day 3: Papuma Side to Tumpak Sewu Staging
@graph.description: The route continues across East Java toward the Tumpak Sewu side. This day works best when guests understand it as overland progression rather than as downtime between headline stops.

item.name: Check out from hotel
item.description: Check out hotel. Complete the standard hotel check-out process in Jember, confirm departure readiness, and prepare for the early transfer toward the early Tumpak Sewu (Lumajang) area.

item.name: Journey to Tumpak Sewu
item.description: Transfer to Tumpak Sewu waterfall. Depart from the hotel in Jember and begin the direct overland drive to the Tumpak Sewu area, using the allocated travel window for the point-to-point transfer.

item.name: Explore Tumpak Sewu Waterfall
item.description: Arrive at the Tumpak Sewu area (Lumajang), and explore Tumpak Sewu Waterfall. Use this activity block for the on-site waterfall experience in the Tumpak Sewu area, following the planned visit duration for exploration and viewing as scheduled.

item.name: Lunch
item.description: Finish explore Tumpak Sewu and having lunch at local warung in Tumpak Sewu area

item.name: Transfer to Bromo
item.description: Transfer to hotel in Bromo area

@graph.name: Day 4: Tumpak Sewu and Transfer Toward the Bromo Side
@graph.description: The waterfall segment adds a different physical rhythm before the route continues toward the Bromo side. This is one of the strongest contrast days in the itinerary and should be treated as real terrain, not a soft add-on.

item.name: Bromo Jeep Tour Experience
item.description: Starting the Bromo Jeep tour. Begin the sunrise tour sequence by Jeep in the Mount Bromo area, following the planned route flow for the morning program.

item.name: Hotel Breakfast
item.description: Back to the hotel for breakfast. Return from the Bromo morning program to the hotel and take a short breakfast break before check-out and departure.

item.name: Bromo Hotel Check-out
item.description: Check-out from the hotel. Complete the hotel check-out process and prepare for the overland transfer to Surabaya.

item.name: Transfer to Surabaya
item.description: Journey to Surabaya. Start the road transfer from the Bromo area to Surabaya as scheduled, concluding the Bromo segment for the day.

item.name: Finish at Surabaya City
item.description: Arrive in Surabaya and proceed with the final transfer to your requested drop-off (hotel/airport). Tour ends after drop-off completion.

@graph.name: Day 5: Bromo Sunrise and Final Return
@graph.description: The final day completes the Bromo sequence before the route returns for the last handoff. It works best for guests who want the full East Java story rather than only the shortest route to the headline volcanoes.

item.name: Breakfast and Free Time
item.description: Breakfast at the hotel and free time until check-out time. This block is reserved for your morning meal and unstructured time at the hotel before the scheduled airport transfer.

item.name: Transfer to Juanda Airport
item.description: Pick up at your hotel lobby (planned 3 hours before your flight departure time) and transfer to Juanda Airport. This segment covers the direct road transfer to the airport for your departure connection.

(Translated by Google) I was delighted to participate in the meticulously planned 9-day, 8-night itinerary by JVTO Java Volcano Tours. From the initial itinerary consultation, to the professional guide's explanations, to the impeccable transportation and accommodation arrangements, to the breathtaking volcanic landscapes, every detail showcased the team's dedication and professionalism.
This trip left us with unforgettable and wonderful memories.

(Original)
非常開心參加由 JVTO爪哇火山旅遊公司為我們精心規劃的行程。這趟旅程是9天8夜的客製化行程。由最初的行程溝通，到專業的導覽解說、再來完善的交通、住宿安排，到震撼人心的火山景觀，每一個細節都展現出團隊的用心與專業。
這次旅程留下難以忘懷的美好回憶。

Trip of a Lifetime: East Java Adventure

Our recent journey through East Java with JVTO was nothing short of extraordinary. We took the 5D4N package and over the course of several days, we explored some of the region's most iconic destinations, including Tumpak Sewu Waterfall, Mount Bromo, and Mount Ijen.

Overall Experience:
Everything is prepared and well-planned for the entire trip. All detailed information is written on the website and you will easily have a worry - free journey.
Their passion for East Java was infectious, and their attention to detail ensured that every aspect of our trip was smooth and enjoyable. From arranging comfortable accommodations to recommending local delicacies, JVTO went above and beyond to make this trip unforgettable.

Conclusion:
We cannot recommend JVTO highly enough for anyone planning to explore East Java. Their expertise, professionalism, and genuine enthusiasm for sharing the wonders of their homeland made our journey an absolute delight.

Thank you, Freddy and Juan , for an incredible adventure that exceeded all expectations.
We look forward to our next exploration with you!

Final Thoughts:
If you're looking for a memorable tour experience that goes beyond the typical sights, JVTO is the perfect choice.
Thank you, JVTO for an unforgettable day!
Yandi and Dosi made our 5 Days 4 Nights tour to Ijen, Papuma, Tumpak Sewu, Bromo, and Surabaya truly enjoyable. Highly recommend their services!

5 days of Java packed wirh vulcanos and adventure. Best Team and awsome scenery. We were oicked up at the airport and taken on a big adventur Tour. With a nice driver and a perfekt Guide. They took us to a waterfall and up to two beautiful vulcanos. It was marvelous.

One of the best tours I have been on so far, the itinerary was very well planned - the hikes paced out perfectly to ensure enough rest, time allocated in each attraction is also sufficient to really explore, the hotels & food are amazing, way beyond our expectations. Besides the great itinerary, the guides (Juan & Yandi) are amazing at bringing us around, extremely friendly and fun to be around. Lastly, Sam who helped to organise the tour is extremely helpful at solving all our needs pre, during and after the entire tour. Would highly recommend this tour package - 10/10!!!
